triples.evidence_text: Vent outlets are to be fitted with corrosion resistant flame-screens.

triples.tail_surface: inspection of the closure and the inside of the casing as well as changing the seals
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 检查关闭件及壳体内部并更换密封
triples.evidence_text: Vent outlet automatic closing devices are to be constructed to allow inspection of the closure and the inside of the casing as well as changing the seals.

Bars, cage or other devices are to be provided to prevent the ball or float from contacting the inner chamber in its normal state and made in such a way that the ball or float is not damaged when subjected to water impact due to a tank being overfilled.

triples.head_surface: ingress of sea water splashes or rain water into the fuel oil tanks
triples.head_canonical_zh: 海水飞溅或雨水进入燃油舱
triples.tail_surface: Vents for fuel oil service and settling tanks directly serving the propulsion and generator engines are to be so located and arranged that in the event of a broken vent pipe, this will not directly lead to the risk of ingress of sea water splashes or rain water into the fuel oil tanks
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 燃油日用柜和沉淀柜透气管的布置与定位
triples.evidence_text: Vents for fuel oil service and settling tanks directly serving the propulsion and generator engines are to be so located and arranged that in the event of a broken vent pipe, this will not directly lead to the risk of ingress of sea water splashes or rain water into the fuel oil tanks.

triples.head_surface: ingress of sea water splashes or rain water
triples.tail_surface: Vents for lubricating oil tanks directly serving propulsion and generator engines, where terminated on weather deck are to be so located and arranged that in the event of a broken vent pipe, this will not directly lead to the risk of ingress of sea water splashes or rain water
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 主机及发电机润滑油舱透气管在露天甲板的布置与定位
triples.evidence_text: Vents for lubricating oil tanks directly serving propulsion and generator engines, where terminated on weather deck are to be so located and arranged that in the event of a broken vent pipe, this will not directly lead to the risk of ingress of sea water splashes or rain water.

triples.head_surface: oil pollution of the marine environment
triples.evidence_text: Vents from fuel oil and other oil tanks, which, in the event of an inadvertent overflow, may result in oil pollution of the marine environment, are to be fitted with overflow arrangements (see 4-6-4/9.5.5) or means of containment, such as coaming, in way of vent outlets.
